answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the ripple of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A shale of per-task receipts records who did what, and the crystal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
